notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30570757/5864c359432ae141c87f6fb90904e4534c9c9fcb.png

This month the air is cooling and the colors are changing.  As we recently announced, we're preparing for blockades!  There are a couple of event blockades that will happen before we open islands up for ownership.  This is so we can test blockades before we have something as valuable as island ownership on the line.  Check out the announcement linked above for more information.  

Stock up now mates and start talking with the other flags in your faction.  It's time to determine how much are you willing to risk.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30570757/4153b0d0f0cd1cf164dccba8c27494ee21838d9e.png

This month we're making the Harvest Class Cutter available the entire month of November.  Hop into a shipyard today to order your very own floating feast.  Additionally we have recently made the following changes:

You will no longer see the change log on the notice board when you log in.  The wall of text is now gone.  Don't worry, you can still access it by clicking on the change log image on the front tab of the notice board.Winning PvP battles against the opposing faction will now award everyone aboard the vessel an untradeable faction trinket. These trinkets will be used to purchase faction-related equipment at the Trading Post in the future, so start stockpiling now!
 Added and initial set of trophies related to Faction PvP. The conditions will need to be discovered by players! 
A black market was added to Point Venture.  There you can purchase specialized items.  Black Boxes will not award Sea Monster maps for currently disabled Sea Monster zones.
Small decrease to the average value of Greedy Purses in preparation for Trading Posts.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30570757/1536d67ac25d5aab30a8a3b3c57cc487fb8b3913.png

This November, savor the bounty of the Puzzle Pirates Vineyard in the Wine Mystery Box! As yer well aware, only the finest libations come in box form.  Sailin' the high seas, ye need to pack yer hold with efficiency so as to maximize yer trade profits. Ye also want to make certain yer cargo is secure in the event ye encounter flying cannonballs, whirlpools or rocks on yer journey. Just tip it and discern Wine Sea Otters, Merlot Macaws, Syrah Snake, and more.
 
From now until 3:00 PM PST on November 20, 2017, you'll earn a free Wine Mystery Box for every $9.99 you spend on doubloons, or every month of subscription time you purchase!

For more information about the full contents of the 2017 Wine Mystery Box, as well as the official rules, please click here. Tip the box back and make the best of wine time, before it's gone for the season!

notes.title: Spyglass: A Developer Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30570757/93f0f25326002209686d45001687a8cd0d1ef671.jpg

Ahoy Mates!

First, thank ye fine mates who've been sending us feedback!  That's been incredibly helpful.  The next big item to hit the seas will be blockades.  We're currently working on plans, but welcome yer input.  

Since release last week, we've implemented the following changes:
Fixed issue that caused many of the buildings to suddenly disappear.
Adding a "CPU Bugfix" checkbox at the bottom of Ye:Options:General, which can be used by players affected by excessive CPU usage when using Steam. This option may interfere with the behavior of the Steam overlay when making a purchase.  If ye run into that, uncheck the box.
Switching to a wrapped parlor badge in the Eminent Explorer pack.  This way ye pirates can open it whenever ye wish. 
Increasing max poker buy-in to 20,000 pieces of eight.  And increased poker rake to 5%.
Fixed the "Navigation" action on the Shadow sloop's navigation wheel.
Fixed bug that allowed DLC to be claimed on oceans other than Obsidian.
Typing "nh" in chat will no longer auto-swap to "nice hand", since that abbreviation is also used for Night Harbour.
Updating Huracan island walkability
 Adjusting the idle logoff delay to more time before ye are auto-logged off.
Fix for bug that could cause holders of the permanent labor badge to be treated as dormant.  This should correct issues where offline labor wasn't being used.
 Modifying the colors of the shadow panther from the Battle Box to make it more distinct.  
Ye can find the change log here. 

We have a few items we're currently working on.  This is by no means a complete list:

Building arrows have declared a mutiny and have disappeared from islands.  For now, please try using the mini-map in the upper right to navigate to buildings.
Plans for blockade openings.  
Issues with the Steam Overlay not working correctly.
Issues installing the game the first time.  Most of these have already been fixed, though a few are lingering.
The new "War" tab of the Notice Board is still being constructed and redesigned. Let us know if there's certain info you'd like to see here.
Additional Steam achievements.
Steam trading cards.   
    
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30570757/a3808c523f8c01083169d7b7036e24683105e729.png

As many of ye mates know, every other month we like to release a special box themed to a limited edition color.  This year we’ve asked our chocolate artisans to put together a box with the highest quality cocoa confections. Act now to uncover Chocolate Spiders familiars, Chocolate and Brown Serpents, Chocolate Jaguar Pets, Azarbad the Great Figurine, ships, furniture, clothing, chromas, 'n more!

The elusive and sweet smelling Fudgefoot has been spotted hiding amongst the other goodies in this month’s Chocolate Mystery Box.  Rumor has it this sweet sasquatch can melt even the stalest pirate heart.
 
From now until 3:00 PM PDT on October 2nd, 2017 ye'll receive a free Chocolate Mystery Box fer every $9.99 ye spend on doubloons.  Boxes are not awarded fer DLC purchases.

Fer more information about the full contents of the 2017 Chocolate Mystery Box, as well as the official rules, please click here. The Chocolate Mystery Boxes are only available for a limited time, so dip into one today!
